# VATTAMS Academy

> VATTAMS Academy is an online education platform serving learners through structured courses, tutor-led classes, competitive exam preparation, skills development, competitions and certificates.

## Core learning areas

- Academic subjects
- Vedic Maths and Abacus
- Public Speaking and Spoken English
- Coding, Python and AI fundamentals
- Competitive exam preparation
- International English/exam preparation
- Student competitions and assessments
- Digital certificates and verification

Website: https://vattams.net
